mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, question_id, knowledge_id, level, consecutive_correct, next_review_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM mastery WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND question_id = #{questionId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mastery (student_id, question_id, knowledge_id, level, consecutive_correct, next_review_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{knowledgeId}, #{level}, #{consecutiveCorrect}, #{nextReviewAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE knowledge_id = VALUES(knowledge_id), level = VALUES(level), consecutive_correct = VALUES(consecutive_correct), next_review_at = VALUES(next_review_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, question_id, knowledge_id, level, consecutive_correct, next_review_at FROM mastery WHERE next_review_at <= #{today} AND level < 2 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY next_review_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(kp.id AS CHAR) AS knowledgeId, kp.name AS knowledgeName, COUNT(m.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN m.level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS masteredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN m.level < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unMasteredCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(m.id) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.level = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(m.id) THEN 2 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.level > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level FROM knowledge_point kp LEFT JOIN mastery m ON m.knowledge_id = kp.id AND m.student_id = #{studentId} AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE kp.is_high_freq = 1 AND kp.status = 0 AND kp.deleted = 0 GROUP BY kp.id, kp.name ORDER BY kp.sort ASC
